definition_zh: 待洗的衣物；洗衣房；洗衣店；洗衣
definition_en: clothes and sheets that need washing or have just been washed; a place or business where they are washed; the work of washing them
core_image: 堆在篮子里的衬衫、毛巾和床单，旁边是一台洗衣机
scene: 周末的早上，装满脏衣服的篮子放在洗衣机旁，主人却一直没有动手。 The basket of laundry sat beside the washing machine all weekend.
sceneCN: 这里是「待洗的衣物」（第 1 个义项：需要清洗的织物）；句意是那篮待洗的衣物整个周末都放在洗衣机旁。图中可辨识物件：洗衣篮、衬衫、洗衣机。

pos.zh: 待洗的衣物；洗衣房；洗衣店；洗衣

collocations.zh: 脏衣服；不可告人的丑事

derivatives.zh: 由 laundry 去掉名词后缀 -ry 逆构而成，义为「洗熨衣物；洗钱」
由 launder 加表示「小型场所」的后缀 -ette 构成，义为「自助洗衣店」
由 launder 加表示「女性从业者」的后缀 -ess 构成，义为「洗衣妇」

senses.title: Clothes and linen that need washing
senses.definition: clothes, sheets and other household linen that need washing or have just been washed
senses.definitionCN: 需要清洗或刚刚洗好的衣服、床单等家用织物
senses.example: The basket of laundry sat beside the washing machine all weekend.
senses.exampleCN: 那篮待洗的衣物整个周末都放在洗衣机旁。
senses.why: The Old French source named the place and the store of things to be washed, and English first used the word for that heap of cloth.
senses.whyCN: 古法语来源既指场所，也指待洗的一堆东西，英语最初便用这个词指那堆织物。

senses.title: A room or shop where clothes are washed
senses.definition: a room in a house, or a shop, where clothes are washed
senses.definitionCN: 住宅内的洗衣房间，或专门清洗衣物的店铺
senses.example: He took his shirts to the laundry on the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 他把衬衫送到街角的洗衣店。
senses.why: The word first named the place where washing happened, and that place sense survives beside the heap of clothes.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指洗衣发生的场所，而这个场所义一直与那堆衣物并存。

senses.title: The work or business of washing clothes
senses.definition: the activity or trade of washing clothes and linen
senses.definitionCN: 清洗衣物与织物的活动或行业
senses.example: Laundry is the one chore she never puts off.
senses.exampleCN: 洗衣服是她唯一不会拖延的家务。
senses.why: Because the place and the task were always linked, the word could also name the activity itself, much as cook gave cooking.
senses.whyCN: 由于场所与任务始终相连，这个词也能指活动本身，就像 cook 派生出 cooking 一样。

intro.en: Laundry comes from a Latin verb for washing by way of French; the place, the clothes and the task have shared the word for centuries.
intro.cn: laundry 由拉丁语「洗」的动词经法语传来；场所、衣物与洗衣这件事共用这个词已有数百年。

items.en: The Latin verb lavare meant to wash, and it also underlies words such as lavatory.
items.cn: 拉丁语动词 lavare 意为洗，lavatory 等词也由它派生。

items.en: Late Latin lavandaria named things to be washed or a place for washing them.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语 lavandaria 指待洗之物或清洗它们的场所。

items.en: Old French lavanderie named the place where washing was done and the household linen handled there.
items.cn: 古法语 lavanderie 指洗衣的场所，也指在那里处理的家庭织物。

items.en: Middle English lavendrie lost the first v and moved towards the modern shape laundry.
items.cn: 中古英语 lavendrie 丢掉第一个 v，逐渐向现代形式 laundry 靠拢。

items.en: Modern English uses laundry for the clothes, the room or shop, and the work itself.
items.cn: 现代英语用 laundry 指衣物、洗衣房间或店铺，也指洗衣这件事。

note.en: The look-alike group collects the verb and the people and places built on it; the near-meaning group collects words for cloth and cleaning.
note.cn: 形近组收由它派生的动词、人和场所；近义组收表示织物与清洁的词。

entries.definition: To wash and iron clothes, or to move money through a legitimate business.
entries.definitionCN: 洗熨衣物；也指通过合法生意洗钱。

entries.definition: A self-service laundry with coin-operated machines.
entries.definitionCN: 设有投币机器的自助洗衣店。

entries.definition: A woman whose job was to wash clothes.
A toilet or washroom; it shares the Latin verb for washing.
entries.definitionCN: 厕所或洗手间；与 laundry 共用拉丁语「洗」的动词。

entries.definition: Clothes that are being washed or have just been washed.
entries.definitionCN: 正在洗或刚洗好的衣物。

entries.definition: Sheets, tablecloths and similar household cloth.
entries.definitionCN: 床单、桌布一类的家用织物。

entries.definition: Items worn on the body, whether clean or dirty.
entries.definitionCN: 穿在身上的衣物，无论干净与否。

entries.definition: A washing method that uses chemicals rather than water.
entries.definitionCN: 用化学溶剂而非水来清洁衣物的方法。

normalIntro.en: The family hangs on a Latin verb for washing, and English suffixes turn it into a shop, a worker and a verb.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词族挂在拉丁语表示「洗」的动词上，英语后缀又把它变成店铺、从业者和动词。

normal.en: Laundry goes back to Latin lavare, to wash, the same verb behind lavatory and lavation.
normal.cn: laundry 可追溯到拉丁语 lavare「洗」，lavatory 与 lavation 也出自同一个动词。

normal.en: Launder is the verb formed from the noun, and it now also means to wash dirty money clean.
normal.cn: launder 是从名词变出的动词，如今也指把来路不干净的钱「洗」干净。

normal.en: Launderette is a small self-service laundry, with -ette marking a compact place.
normal.cn: launderette 是小型自助洗衣店，后缀 -ette 标记一个较小的场所。

normal.en: Laundress is the old word for a woman who washed clothes, with -ess marking a female worker.
normal.cn: laundress 是旧时指洗衣妇女的词，后缀 -ess 标记女性从业者。

normal.en: Laundry basket is the place where the heap waits, which is why the word can mean both the heap and the task.
normal.cn: laundry basket 是那堆衣物等待的地方，所以这个词既能指那堆衣物，也能指洗衣这件事。

abstract.en: A word that means the clothes, the room and the work shows how domestic labour blurs object and action.
abstract.cn: 一个同时指衣物、房间和工作的词，说明家务劳动如何把物件与动作混在一起。

abstract.en: Clean water is the hidden subject of laundry, just as it is of so much household life.
abstract.cn: 干净的水是 laundry 背后隐藏的主题，正如它在许多家庭生活中那样。

abstract.en: Laundry waits in a basket until someone decides to begin, which makes it a small picture of unfinished time.
abstract.cn: 衣物在篮子里等着有人决定开始，这使它成为未完成时间的一幅小图。

examples.en: The basket of laundry sat beside the washing machine all weekend.
examples.cn: 那篮待洗的衣物整个周末都放在洗衣机旁。

examples.en: He took his shirts to the laundry on the corner.
examples.cn: 他把衬衫送到街角的洗衣店。

examples.en: Laundry is the one chore she never puts off.
examples.cn: 洗衣服是她唯一不会拖延的家务。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「落恩缀」——脏衣服落进篮子，等着人去洗；laundry 是待洗的衣物。

root: 拉丁语 lavare（洗）→ 晚期拉丁语 lavandaria（待洗之物、洗衣处）→ 古法语 lavanderie → 中古英语 lavendrie → 现代英语 laundry。

sensesIntro.en: The core is the heap of cloth to be washed; the senses divide into the place where it is washed and the work of washing it.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是待洗的一堆织物；义项由此分为清洗它的场所和清洗这件事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a basket of shirts, towels and sheets beside a washing machine.
core.cn: 核心意象：洗衣机旁一篮衬衫、毛巾和床单。

branches.en: a heap of shirts waiting beside a machine
branches.cn: 机器旁等待的一堆衬衫

branches.en: a basket that stays full until Sunday night
branches.cn: 一直满到周日夜晚的洗衣篮

branches.en: a shop on the corner with rows of machines
branches.cn: 街角一排排机器的店铺

branches.en: a small room at the back of a house
branches.cn: 住宅后部的一间小屋

branches.en: a chore that begins with sorting and ends with folding
branches.cn: 从分类开始、以叠好结束的家务

intro.en: A Latin verb for washing travels through French into English, where suffixes build a verb, a shop and a female worker.
intro.cn: 拉丁语表示「洗」的动词经法语进入英语，英语再用后缀造出动词、店铺和女性从业者。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin cognate is recorded for this word.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有可靠的拉丁同族词记录。

items.meaning: clothes or a place for washing them
a basket for clothes to be washed

definition_zh: 紫罗兰；紫罗兰色；紫色的
definition_en: a small spring flower with purple petals, or the bluish-purple colour of it
core_image: 墙根下几朵小小的紫花，藏在叶子中间
scene: 早春的花坛边，几朵紫花从枯叶里探出来，矮矮的，不显眼。 A few violets had opened under the hedge before the last frost.
sceneCN: 这里 violet 是「紫罗兰」（第 1 个义项：花瓣呈紫蓝色的小型春季花卉）；句意为末次霜降前，树篱下已有几朵紫罗兰开了。花坛边藏在叶间的小紫花正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 加后缀 -aceous 构成，义为「紫罗兰色的」
加前缀 ultra- 构成，义为「紫外的」
加后缀 -like 构成，义为「似紫罗兰的」

senses.title: A small spring flower of the violet family
senses.definition: a low plant with purple or bluish flowers that blooms in spring
senses.definitionCN: 一种春天开紫蓝色花的矮小植物
senses.example: A few violets had opened under the hedge before the last frost.
senses.exampleCN: 末次霜降前，树篱下已有几朵紫罗兰开了。
senses.why: Latin viola named the flower long before any colour took its name.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 viola 早在任何颜色以它命名之前就指这种花。

senses.title: The bluish-purple colour
senses.definition: a colour between blue and purple, like the petal of the flower
senses.definitionCN: 介于蓝与紫之间的颜色，如花瓣之色
senses.example: The evening sky turned a deep violet.
senses.exampleCN: 傍晚的天空变成深紫罗兰色。
senses.why: Flowers are the easiest colour samples, so the bloom lent its name to a hue.
senses.whyCN: 花是最方便的颜色样本，于是花朵把名字借给了这一色调。

senses.title: As an adjective, of that colour
senses.definition: having the colour of the violet flower
senses.definitionCN: 具有紫罗兰花的颜色
senses.example: She wore a violet ribbon in her hair.
senses.exampleCN: 她头发上系着一条紫色缎带。
senses.why: Once the noun names a colour, it can stand before another noun as a description.
senses.whyCN: 名词一旦指某种颜色，就能放在另一名词前作修饰。

senses.title: Part of the visible spectrum near ultraviolet
senses.definition: the part of the spectrum just beyond blue, next to ultraviolet
senses.definitionCN: 光谱中紧接蓝色、靠近紫外线的一端
senses.example: Violet is the last colour the eye can see before darkness.
senses.exampleCN: 紫色是眼睛在进入黑暗前能看见的最后一种颜色。
senses.why: Physics needed a name for the short-wave end, and the deepest flower colour supplied it.
senses.whyCN: 物理学需要为短波一端命名，而最深的花色刚好胜任。

senses.title: In chemistry, a violet colour as a test result
senses.definition: the purple colour that signals a particular reaction
senses.definitionCN: 表示某一特定反应的紫色现象
senses.example: The liquid turned violet when the iodine was added.
senses.exampleCN: 加入碘之后液体变成了紫色。
senses.why: Laboratory notes borrow colour words, because a change of hue is the result.
senses.whyCN: 实验室记录借用颜色词，因为色调变化本身就是结果。

intro.en: Violet comes from Latin viola, the flower, through French.
intro.cn: violet 经法语来自拉丁语 viola（这种花）。

items.en: Viola was the Latin name for the violet and similar plants.
items.cn: viola 是拉丁语中紫罗兰及其近缘植物的名称。

items.en: Violarium named a bed of such flowers.
items.cn: violarium 指种着这类花的花圃。

items.en: French violete named the little flower with a diminutive ending.
items.cn: 法语 violete 以指小词尾命名这种小花。

items.en: English took violette, later shortened to violet.
items.cn: 英语借入 violette，后简作 violet。

items.en: The colour sense grew from the flower and reached physics.
items.cn: 颜色义由花而来，最终进入物理学。

note.en: The first group holds the violet family, the second the colours and flowers it stands among.
note.cn: 第一组是 violet 词族，第二组是与其并列的颜色与花卉词。

entries.definition: more than one flower
of a violet colour
beyond violet in the spectrum
using great force
the colour of ripe plums
a pale purple, or its bush
a pale purple herb
a garden flower of the violet family

normalIntro.en: A small flower first, a colour second: the name travels from the garden to the paint pot.
normalIntro.cn: 先是小花，才是颜色：名字从花园走进了颜料盒。

normal.en: Violet and violin both start with vio-, but share no root.
normal.cn: violet 与 violin 都以 vio- 开头，却不同源。

normal.en: Ultraviolet puts ultra- before the colour.
normal.cn: ultraviolet 在颜色词前加 ultra-。

normal.en: The plural is violets, plainly adding s.
normal.cn: 复数 violets，直接加 s。

normal.en: Violet is two syllables with the stress on the first.
normal.cn: violet 两个音节，重音在第一个。

normal.en: The Latin plant name viola also gives the instrument’s name.
normal.cn: 拉丁植物名 viola 也给出了乐器名。

abstract.en: See a few small purple flowers under a hedge.
abstract.cn: 想树篱下几朵小小的紫花。

abstract.en: Picture the sky going deep purple after sunset.
abstract.cn: 想日落后天色转成深紫。

abstract.en: Hear a ribbon rustle in a child’s hair.
abstract.cn: 听孩子发间缎带的窸窣声。

examples.en: She picked a violet for her buttonhole.
examples.cn: 她摘了一朵紫罗兰别在扣眼上。

examples.en: The dye gave the cloth a soft violet shade.
examples.cn: 这染料把布染成了柔和的紫色。

examples.en: Too much violet in the photo makes it look cold.
examples.cn: 照片里紫色过多显得冷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「喂来特」——喂，快来看这朵特紫的小花，就是紫罗兰。

root: 拉丁语 viola（紫罗兰属植物）→ 古法语 violete → 英语 violet

sensesIntro.en: One flower name becomes a colour, an adjective, a band of the spectrum, and a sign in the lab.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个花名变成了颜色、形容词、光谱的一端与实验室里的现象。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: small purple flowers under a hedge.
core.cn: 核心意象：树篱下的小紫花。

branches.en: The garden branch: flowers opening before the frost.
branches.cn: 花园分支：霜前绽开的花。

branches.en: The sky branch: deep violet after sunset.
branches.cn: 天空分支：日落后的深紫。

branches.en: The ribbon branch: a violet band in the hair.
branches.cn: 缎带分支：发间的紫色带子。

branches.en: The spectrum branch: the last colour before dark.
branches.cn: 光谱分支：黑暗之前的最后一色。

branches.en: The test-tube branch: liquid turning violet.
branches.cn: 试管分支：液体变紫。

intro.en: The root viol- names the flower and its colour; -et is a French diminutive ending.
intro.cn: 词根 viol- 指这种花与其色，-et 是法语指小词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin viola gives the plant; French added the diminutive -ete, English kept the shortened -et.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 viola 给出植物名，法语加指小词尾 -ete，英语保留了缩短的 -et。

items.example: Viol- is the plant in violet.
items.exampleCN: viol- 是 violet 中的那种植物。

items.example: The ending once meant a little flower.
A violet-like scent filled the room.
items.exampleCN: 屋里充满似紫罗兰的香气。

items.meaning: the plant genus, and an instrument

items.example: Purple covers more shades than violet.
items.exampleCN: purple 涵盖的色调比 violet 更广。

definition_zh: 值得钦佩的；令人赞赏的；出色的；令人敬佩的勇气；可贵的品质；可赞美的事；克制的表现；极好的
definition_en: deserving respect and approval because of good qualities, actions, or achievements
core_image: 众人抬头看向台上那个人，目光停住，心里升起一句「值得敬佩」
scene: 博物馆的展厅里，人群在旧照片前安静下来，一位老人站得笔直。 Her calm dignity in the crowded hall was truly admirable.
sceneCN: 这里 admirable 是「值得钦佩的」（第 1 个义项：因品格或行为而值得尊敬）；句意为她在拥挤大厅中的从容与尊严确实令人钦佩。

pos.zh: 形容词：值得钦佩的；令人赞赏的；出色的

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉形容词后缀 -able 得到的动词，义为「钦佩；欣赏」
由 admirable 变 -able 为 -ably 构成副词，义为「令人钦佩地；出色地」
由 admirable 加名词后缀 -ness 构成，义为「令人钦佩之处」
由拉丁词基 admir- 加名词后缀 -ation 构成，义为「钦佩；赞赏」
由 admire 加表示施动者的后缀 -er 构成，义为「钦佩者；爱慕者」

senses.title: Deserving respect and approval
senses.definition: deserving to be respected and approved of because of good qualities or actions
senses.definitionCN: 因良好的品格或行为而值得尊敬与赞许
senses.example: Her patience under pressure was admirable.
senses.exampleCN: 她在压力下的耐心令人钦佩。
senses.why: The core image is a head raised toward someone: what is seen there earns respect before any word is spoken.
senses.whyCN: 核心意象是抬头望向某人：看到的东西先赢得敬意，话还没有说出口。

senses.title: Arousing praise or pleasure
senses.definition: causing someone to feel praise or pleasure when they see or hear it
senses.definitionCN: 让人看到或听到之后产生赞赏与愉悦
senses.example: The choir gave an admirable performance.
senses.exampleCN: 合唱团献上了一场令人赞赏的演出。
senses.why: The raised eyes now bring pleasure as well as respect: the thing is not only good but good to behold.
senses.whyCN: 抬起的目光如今除了敬意还带来愉悦：对象不只是好，而且看着就让人愉快。

senses.title: Of especially high quality
senses.definition: especially good in quality, skill, or achievement
senses.definitionCN: 在质量、技艺或成就上格外好
senses.example: He wrote an admirable account of the long voyage.
senses.exampleCN: 他把那次远航写得十分出色。
senses.why: Respect hardens into a judgement of quality: the thing admired is placed above the ordinary.
senses.whyCN: 敬意凝固为对质量的判断：被钦佩之物被放到寻常水准之上。

senses.title: Admirable courage: bravery worth respecting
senses.definition: used of courage that deserves respect because it is shown in a hard or dangerous situation
senses.definitionCN: 用于描述在艰难或危险处境中表现出的、值得尊敬的勇气
senses.example: The firefighters showed admirable courage in the blaze.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员在火场中表现出令人敬佩的勇气。
senses.why: Courage is the quality that most clearly earns the raised gaze, because it is shown at a cost.
senses.whyCN: 勇气是最能赢得那道仰望目光的品质，因为它总是以付出为代价显现。

senses.title: Admirable quality: a valuable trait
senses.definition: used of a personal quality that is worth praising and worth keeping
senses.definitionCN: 用于描述值得赞扬、值得保有的个人品质
senses.example: Honesty is an admirable quality in any leader.
senses.exampleCN: 诚实在任何领导者身上都是可贵的品质。
senses.why: The gaze moves from a deed to the trait behind it: what is praised is the lasting disposition.
senses.whyCN: 目光从一次行为移到行为背后的特质：被赞美的是那种持久的品性。

senses.title: Worthy of praise as an act
senses.definition: used of an action that deserves praise rather than blame
senses.definitionCN: 用于描述应当受到赞扬而非责备的行为
senses.example: Her decision to speak out was admirable.
senses.exampleCN: 她决定公开说出真相，这件事值得赞美。
senses.why: Here the judgement falls on a single act: the raised gaze approves what was done, not who did it.
senses.whyCN: 这里的判断落在一个具体行为上：那道仰望的目光认可「做了什么」，而不论是谁做的。

senses.title: Admirable restraint: controlled behaviour
senses.definition: used of self-control that earns respect, especially when anger or reply is held back
senses.definitionCN: 用于描述赢得尊敬的自我克制，尤指忍住怒气或不作回击
senses.example: He met the insult with admirable restraint.
senses.exampleCN: 他以令人钦佩的克制面对那句侮辱。
senses.why: Restraint is courage turned inward: the person holds back, and the held-back force is what earns respect.
senses.whyCN: 克制是向内收住的勇气：人忍住了，而被忍住的那股力量正是赢得敬意之处。

senses.title: Extremely good in informal praise
senses.definition: in informal speech, used to mean extremely good, impressive, or well done
senses.definitionCN: 在口语中表示「极好的、令人印象深刻、干得漂亮」
senses.example: That was an admirable catch at the last second.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一秒的那次接球真是漂亮。
senses.why: The word loosens in talk: respect becomes a warm, casual compliment rather than a solemn judgement.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在口语里松动了：敬意变成一句温和随意的称赞，而不再是一本正经的评判。

intro.en: Admirable is admire plus the suffix -able, and both rest on a Latin verb of wondering.
intro.cn: admirable 是 admire 加后缀 -able 构成的形容词，两者都建立在拉丁语中表示「惊奇」的动词上。

items.en: mirari meant 'to wonder at, be amazed'; it comes from mirus 'wonderful'. The deeper origin of the root is source uncertain.
items.cn: mirari 意为「惊奇、惊叹」，来自 mirus「奇妙的」；该词根更早的来源不确定。

items.en: ad- 'to, at' plus mirari gave admirari, 'to wonder at, regard with admiration'.
items.cn: ad-「向、对」加 mirari 构成 admirari，意为「对……感到惊奇、以钦佩的目光看待」。

items.en: The adjective admirabilis meant 'worthy of wonder, wonderful'; -bilis marks what can or deserves to be done.
items.cn: 形容词 admirabilis 意为「值得惊叹的、奇妙的」；后缀 -bilis 表示「可被……或值得被……」。

items.en: English took the word through French, keeping both the 'wondrous' and the 'praiseworthy' senses.
items.cn: 英语经法语吸收这个词，同时保留了「奇妙的」与「值得赞扬的」两层意思。

items.en: -able became a living English suffix, and the meaning narrowed from wonder to praise of good qualities.
items.cn: -able 成为能产的英语后缀，词义也从「惊奇」收窄为对良好品质的赞扬。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the admiration word family; the near-meaning group gathers adjectives of praise with different strength.
note.cn: 形近组收 admiration 这一词族；近义组收表示赞扬的形容词，力度各不相同。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to respect and look at someone or something with approval.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「钦佩、欣赏」，指带着赞许去敬重或观看某人某物。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning in a way that deserves praise.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「令人钦佩地、出色地」，指以值得赞扬的方式。

entries.definition: The noun for the feeling of respect and warm approval.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「钦佩、赞赏」，指尊敬与温暖赞许的感受。

entries.definition: A noun for a person who admires someone, often romantically.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「钦佩者、爱慕者」，常指怀有爱慕之情的人。

entries.definition: A naval officer of high rank; it only looks close, since it comes from Arabic amir.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「海军上将」；只是拼写相近，词源来自阿拉伯语 amir，与钦佩无关。

entries.definition: Deserving praise, often for effort or intention rather than lasting quality.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「值得称赞的」，多因努力或善意而值得赞扬，而非因持久的品质。

entries.definition: Extremely good in quality; a general judgement with no image of respect.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「极好的」，是一般性的质量判断，不含「敬意」的意象。

entries.definition: Deserving formal praise, especially for an action or effort.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「值得表扬的」，语气正式，多用于行为或努力。

entries.definition: Making a strong effect on the mind, often by size or skill.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「令人印象深刻的」，多因规模或技艺而震撼人心。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Latin verb of wondering and the suffixes that build the family.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的拉丁语「惊奇」动词，以及构成这一词族的后缀。

normal.en: mirari means to wonder, so admirable first meant 'wonderful' before it meant 'praiseworthy'.
normal.cn: mirari 意为「惊奇」，所以 admirable 先有「奇妙的」义，后来才有「值得赞扬的」义。

normal.en: The ad- in admire and admirable points the wonder at a particular person or thing.
normal.cn: admire 与 admirable 中的 ad- 把这份惊奇指向某个具体的人或物。

normal.en: Admiration, admirer and admirably all keep the same admir- base.
normal.cn: admiration、admirer、admirably 都保留同一个 admir- 词基。

normal.en: Admirable courage and admirable restraint name two qualities that cost the person something.
normal.cn: admirable courage 与 admirable restraint 都指需要当事人付出代价的品质。

normal.en: Admiral looks similar but comes from Arabic amir, so it is a false friend.
normal.cn: admiral 看起来相近，却来自阿拉伯语 amir，是个假朋友。

abstract.en: Picture a crowd raising its eyes to a stage: no one speaks, yet respect fills the room.
abstract.cn: 想象人群把目光抬向舞台：没有人说话，敬意却充满整个房间。

abstract.en: The same raised eyes can rest on a brave act, a fine painting, or a quietly held temper.
abstract.cn: 同一双抬起的眼睛，可以停在勇敢的行为、精美的画作，或一份默默忍住的脾气上。

abstract.en: When the gaze softens into a smile, the solemn word becomes everyday praise for a clever catch.
abstract.cn: 当目光软化成微笑，这个庄重的词就变成对一次巧妙接球的日常称赞。

examples.en: Her patience under pressure was truly admirable.
examples.cn: 她在压力下的耐心确实令人钦佩。

examples.en: The team made an admirable effort to finish on time.
examples.cn: 团队为按时完成付出了值得赞赏的努力。

examples.en: He accepted the criticism with admirable calm.
examples.cn: 他以令人钦佩的平静接受了批评。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿德默勒布尔」——台下众人抬头看着台上，心里浮出一句「值得敬佩」

root: 拉丁语 admirari「对……感到惊奇、钦佩」由 ad-「向」加 mirari「惊奇」构成，mirari 又来自 mirus「奇妙的」。加形容词后缀 -abilis（英语作 -able）构成 admirabilis，义为「值得惊叹的」。mirari 更早的词源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all start from a raised gaze: respect for a person, pleasure at a sight, high quality, courage, a trait, an act, restraint, and casual praise.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都从一道仰望的目光出发：对人的敬意、观看时的愉悦、高超的质量、勇气、品质、行为、克制，以及随口的称赞。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: eyes are raised toward someone, and respect rises with them before any word is spoken.
core.cn: 核心意象：目光抬向某人，敬意随之升起，话还没有出口。

branches.en: THE PERSON: respect for good character and the pleasure of watching it.
branches.cn: 人的线：对良好品格的敬意，以及观看它时的愉悦。

branches.en: THE STANDARD: respect settles into a judgement that something is above the ordinary.
branches.cn: 标准线：敬意沉淀为判断，认定某物高于寻常水准。

branches.en: THE QUALITIES: courage in danger and a trait that is worth keeping.
branches.cn: 品质线：危难中的勇气，以及值得保有的品性。

branches.en: THE ACTS: a single deed worth praise, and a temper quietly held back.
branches.cn: 行为线：一件值得赞美的行为，以及一份默默忍住的脾气。

branches.en: THE COMPLIMENT: in talk the solemn gaze relaxes into warm, casual praise.
branches.cn: 称赞线：在口语里，庄重的目光放松成温和随意的赞扬。

intro.en: Admirable is a Latin adjective reshaped in English; its suffix -able is still productive today.
intro.cn: admirable 是在英语中改造过的拉丁形容词，它的后缀 -able 至今仍能产。

latinIntro.en: mirus, mirari, admirari and admirabilis are all recorded Latin forms; only the original root is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: mirus、mirari、admirari、admirabilis 都是有记录的拉丁形式，只有最初的词根属于重构。

items.exampleCN: 这个复合动词是 admire 的直接来源。

items.example: It is the Latin shape behind admirable.
items.exampleCN: 它是 admirable 背后的拉丁语形态。
